descriptionMarkdown:
Most non-relic weapons have one modification slot. A master-crafted weapon may have two. A weapon cannot take the 
same modification twice, and a modification must make physical and fictional sense for the weapon. The GM may 
rename an upgrade to match its culture or technology without changing the rule.
Modification Availability Effect
Bayonet / Breaching Lug Issued
A suitable ranged weapon can be used as a 1d6 piercing melee weapon 
without drawing another weapon. It is not Finesse unless the base weapon 
is Light.
Extended Magazine / Charge Pack Controlled Increase the weapon's Reload value by 25%, rounded up. Does not apply 
to Reload 1 weapons or single-use launchers.
Reflex Sight Controlled Once per short rest, after you roll a ranged attack but before the result is 
declared, add +1d4 to the roll.
Camo Wrap / Low-Signature 
Furniture Controlled Advantage on one check per short rest to conceal, hide or disguise the 
weapon.
Recoil Compensation Scarce Once per short rest, ignore disadvantage or another penalty caused 
specifically by moving before firing a Heavy weapon.
Targeting Optic Scarce When you Aim and do not move before the attack, ignore Light Cover on 
one ranged attack.
Reinforced Action Scarce
The first time each mission the weapon would become Damaged because 
of a malfunction, harsh environment or failed maintenance check, it remains 
Serviceable instead.
Sanctified Fittings Rare
Once per turn when the weapon damages a daemon, Warp-Born creature 
or explicitly corrupted target, add +1 radiant damage per weapon damage 
die.
Archeotech Interface Exceptional
Choose one compatible advanced modification that normally could not be 
fitted to this pattern. Installation requires exceptional facilities and GM 
approval.
